title: In an abstract group, a left inverse equals a right inverse
statement: For any group record G (an abstract carrier, binary op, identity e, inverse, associativity, two-sided identity and inverse laws) and elements a b c of G's carrier, if op b a = e and op a c = e then b = c.

formal.statement: theorem Alg.groupInvUnique : ((x0 : Alg.Group) -> ((x1 : Alg.Group.carrier x0) -> ((x2 : Alg.Group.carrier x0) -> ((x3 : Alg.Group.carrier x0) -> ((x4 : Eq.{1} (Alg.Group.carrier x0) (Alg.Group.op x0 x2 x1) (Alg.Group.e x0)) -> ((x5 : Eq.{1} (Alg.Group.carrier x0) (Alg.Group.op x0 x1 x3) (Alg.Group.e x0)) -> Eq.{1} (Alg.Group.carrier x0) x2 x3))))))

evidence.supports: Alg.groupInvUnique admits through the trusted kernel gate and, applied at TWO CONCRETE Alg.Group instances (Int.addGroup, Rat.addGroup) closed over symbolic elements a b c (fun a b c => Alg.groupInvUnique G a b c), type-checks -- confirming the generic proof's chain (b = b*e = b*(a*c) = (b*a)*c = e*c = c, the shape Nat.group_inverse_unique documents) specializes and every selector application (op/e projected off a real Group value) iota-reduces cleanly through both an Int and a Rat instance.
evidence.checker_command: out=$(cargo test -p axeyum-lean-kernel --lib -- group_inv_unique_applies_at_int_and_rat_instances --nocapture --test-threads=1 2>&1) && test "$(printf "%s\n" "$out"| grep -cE 'test result: ok\. 1 passed; 0 failed')" -ge 1
evidence.notes: The pattern is anchored on cargo's own pass/fail summary line with BOTH counts pinned ('1 passed; 0 failed'). The FIRST version of this test used a bare free variable (Kernel::infer on an open term) and failed with UnboundFVar -- an infrastructure defect in the TEST, not the theorem; fixed by closing the application over a b c with lam_over before inferring, so the checked term is closed and needs no LocalContext.

provenance.established_by: axeyum-lean-kernel build_rat_prelude, lane structures-1, ADR-1578 -- proved once over the abstract Alg.Group record and instantiated at two independently-built carriers.

notes: Proves a left inverse equals a right inverse (op b a = e, op a c = e implies b = c), NOT that inverses commute or that the group is abelian -- Alg.Group carries no commutativity field. Does not exercise fully concrete numeral witnesses (a b c stay symbolic; the CONCRETE half is the two structure instances, Int.addGroup and Rat.addGroup).
